title: Crew
blurb: Replay of a recorded run: a lead and its crew of agents building one application together, on Branches of their own. Every recorded write is applied, and a recorded command runs again in a Workspace unless it repeats an earlier run on a Branch that has not changed since, or it only verifies and is not one of the installs or a Branch's last build or test.

set -eo pipefail
